report.summary: All claims UNDECIDABLE because source files vault-path-safety.py and provider-router.py were not located. 14 potential risks identified; ranked by severity. Action: locate missing files and re-run verification.

risks.description: Windows 8.3 short names allow traversal without '..' (e.g., PROJEC~1/..../Windows/win.ini) - vault_rel does not expand short names
risks.blast_radius: Arbitrary file read/write, data exfiltration, system compromise

risks.description: Drive-relative paths (C:foo.md) bypass absolute check because they lack leading / and regex requires colon at position 1
risks.blast_radius: Access to unexpected drives, potential traversal to sensitive areas

risks.description: UNC paths (//server/share/...) bypass absolute check because they start with // not /
risks.blast_radius: Remote path access, potential SSRF or SMB relay

risks.description: TOCTOU race between symlink check (probe.is_symlink()) and resolve() - a symlink can be swapped after check
risks.blast_radius: Symlink attack leading to read/write of unintended files

risks.description: Case-insensitive collisions on Windows (e.g., PAGE.MD vs page.md) not detected, could overwrite existing page
risks.blast_radius: Silent data loss or page content corruption

risks.description: Review-only substring bypass: _is_review_only() matches substrings like 'review' in 'not_review' or 'review_and_apply', allowing write tasks to be misclassified as review-only
risks.blast_radius: Unauthorised write operations bypassing review gate

risks.description: External write lanes trust: no validation that external_write_lanes_for_repo returns expected values; malformed config could silently disable or enable write lanes
risks.blast_radius: Silent enable/disable of write lanes, potential data tampering or loss

risks.description: Trailing dots/spaces only checked per segment before join, but not after path resolution (e.g., 'page.md ' passes segment check but Windows strips space)
risks.blast_radius: Creation of files with tricky names, possible confusion or bypass

risks.description: Unicode normalization (e.g., U+FF0E fullwidth dot) not normalized, so trailing dot check can be bypassed
risks.blast_radius: Path validation bypass leading to similar tricks as trailing dots

risks.description: Fence dominance threshold bypass: small repos (<20 modules) always keep fence UP, but threshold 0.75 can be gamed by adding many non-fenced files to dilute ratio
risks.blast_radius: Fence could be circumvented in larger repos by dilution

risks.description: Model capability mismatch: no check for tool-calling, context window, or modality before routing to a provider (e.g., image task to text-only Ollama)
risks.blast_radius: Silent failures, wasted API costs, degraded output

risks.description: No modality routing: objective may require image/audio but provider may not support it; no check exists
risks.blast_radius: Tasks assigned to incompatible models, causing errors or wrong results

risks.description: Reserved device names checked only on stem (seg.split('.')[0].lower()), so 'CON.txt.md' passes (stem='con') but 'CON' is still a device name
risks.blast_radius: Possible DoS or instability on Windows when accessing device files

risks.description: Silent fallback on provider failure: decide() degrades to Claude without logging or reporting the original provider failure, making debugging hard

todos: Locate source file vault-path-safety.py and re-run verification
Locate source file provider-router.py and re-run verification
Re-assess all undecided claims with actual code

handoff.suggestion: If vulnerabilities are confirmed, apply fixes from round2 reports: atomic symlink ops, drive-relative/UNC rejection, 8.3 expansion, case-folding, Unicode normalization, full segment reserved name check, resolved-path trailing char check, strict review keyword matching, external write lanes validation, fence threshold audit, model capability checks, modality routing, and provider failure logging.
